history.notes: First cut of the bounded metric ledger: a three-tier cascade (raw samples into an open hourly bucket, sealed hours folded into an open daily bucket) with a fixed-capacity ring behind each tier, so both memory and project-backup footprint are capped by configuration. · Local-calendar bucket keys rather than epoch arithmetic, so a daylight-saving day is still exactly one day; a repeated fall-back hour merges into its open bucket instead of duplicating or resurrecting a sealed one. · Insight surface: `METRIC_VALUE` / `METRIC_MIN` / `METRIC_MAX` / `METRIC_AVG` / `METRIC_TREND` / `METRIC_DELTA_1H` / `SAMPLE_COUNT` / `LAST_SAMPLE_AT`, plus events for new extremes, significant change, hour and day rollover, source loss, retention wrap, clear, and export. · Privacy Mode (Full History / Aggregates Only / Paused) outranks Persist Across Reboot (Off / Aggregates Only / Full); tightening privacy retroactively discards raw rows already held. `Storage Estimate` reports the ceiling a configuration can reach in a project backup. · CSV and JSON export, capped at 500 rows and truncated oldest-coarse-first, to the Lua output window or an HTTP endpoint; a rejected send is reported and dropped rather than retried. · Licensing: every control path (record, seal, export, clear) is behind `LicenseGate()`. · Release Candidate, simulation-verified. No representative hardware acceptance yet.
